record.question: Which of the following is not one of the Sustainable Development Goals?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation:
The United Nations’ 2030 Agenda established 17 Sustainable Development Goals. The official list includes Goal 14, Life Below Water, and Goal 15, Life on Land; it has no goal titled “Life on Air.” That phrase is therefore the odd one out. This is a fixed title-list question, so the relevant check is the official goal names rather than a current progress statistic.

Reference: https://sdgs.un.org/goals
